blocks.html: HAVE A GREAT EASTER EGGSPEDITION AT ROBINSONS MALLS
Join in and be part Robinsons Malls' Easter Eggspedition on April 5, Easter Sunday from 10:00 am to 5pm.

Shop at Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Place Manila and enjoy the fun games and activities like Easter Egg hunting, magic show and tea & cookie party slated on April 5, Easter Sunday from 10AM - 5PM.

For a minimum single receipt purchase of Php1,000.00 from March 30 - April 4, you may pre-register a child at the designated information counter and get a ticket to join the Robinsons Malls Easter Eggspedition activities.
